
=== WebPanel: Root.GAMWWRoles ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	&IsAuthorized_Name = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'gamroleentry_Execute')
	
	Form.Caption = 'WWP_GAM_Roles'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	&BtnRole.Title = "WWP_GAM_Children"
	&BtnPrm.Title = "WWP_GAM_Permissions"
	&BtnSaveAs.Title = "WWP_GAM_Copy"
	&BtnSubscriptions.Title = "WWP_GAM_Subscriptions"

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	//&GridPageCount has to be loaded manually
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&GridPageSize = Grid.Rows
	&Filter.Name =  !"%" + &FilName
	&Filter.ExternalId = !"%" + &FilExternalId
	&GAMRoles = GAMRepository.GetRoles(&Filter, &Errors)
	If &GAMRoles.Count = 0
		&GridPageCount = 0
	Else
		&GridPageCount = (&GAMRoles.Count / &GridPageSize) + iif(Mod(&GAMRoles.Count, &GridPageSize) > 0, 1, 0)
	EndIf
	&GridRecordCount = &GAMRoles.Count
	For &Role in &GAMRoles
		&Id	  = &Role.Id
		&Name = &Role.Name
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the data
	
	//Sample conditions to be added manually:
	//Where <Attribute> like &FilName when not &FilName.IsEmpty()
	
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	
	&BtnRole = !'<i class="fa fa-cog"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_BtnRole)
		&BtnRole.Link = GAMWWRoleRoles.Link(&Id, &Id)
	Endif
	&BtnPrm = !'<i class="fa fa-lock"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_BtnPrm)
		&BtnPrm.Link = GAMWWRolePermissions.Link(&Id, 0)
	Endif
	&BtnSaveAs = !'<i class="fas fa-copy"></i>'
	
	&BtnSubscriptions = !'<i class="fas fa-rss"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_BtnSubscriptions)
		&BtnSubscriptions.Link = WWPBaseObjects.Subscriptions.WWP_SubscriptionsSettingsByRole.Link(&Role.GUID)
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_Name)
		&Name.Link = GAMRoleEntry.Link(GAMAPiMode.Display, &Id)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
		Grid.Load()
	EndFor

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'GAMWWRolesFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'GAMWWRolesFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'GAMWWRolesFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		GAMRoleEntry.Call(GAMAPiMode.Insert, 0)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &BtnSaveAs.Click (Event) ---
&Role.Load(&Id)
	&isOK = &Role.SaveAs(&NewGAMRole, &Errors)
	If &isOK
		commit
		Refresh
	Else
		For &Error in &Errors
			Msg(Format(!"%1 (GAM%2)", &Error.Message, &Error.Code))
		EndFor
	Endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: Root.GAMRoleEntry ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&SecurityPolicies = GAMRepository.GetSecurityPolicies(&Filter, &Errors)
	&RoleSecurityPolicyId.AddItem(0,"WWP_GAM_None")
	
	For &SecurityPolicy in &SecurityPolicies
		&RoleSecurityPolicyId.AddItem(&SecurityPolicy.Id,&SecurityPolicy.Name)
	EndFor
	If &Mode <> GAMAPiMode.Insert
		&Role.Load(&Id)
		&RoleId = &Role.Id
		&RoleGUID = &Role.GUID
		&RoleName = &Role.Name
		&RoleDescription = &Role.Description
		&RoleExternalId = &Role.ExternalId
		&RoleSecurityPolicyId = &Role.SecurityPolicyId
	Endif
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Display
		BtnEnter.Visible = False
	Endif
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Display or &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		&RoleSecurityPolicyId.Enabled = False
		&RoleName.Enabled = False
		&RoleDescription.Enabled = False
		&RoleExternalId.Enabled = False
		If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
			BtnEnter.Caption = "Delete"
		endif
	Endif
	&Role.Id	= &Id
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
&Role.Load(&Id)
	Do Case
		Case &Mode = GAMAPiMode.Insert or &Mode = GAMAPiMode.Update
			&Role.Name = &RoleName
			&Role.Description = &RoleDescription
			&Role.ExternalId = &RoleExternalId
			&Role.SecurityPolicyId = &RoleSecurityPolicyId
			&Role.Save()
		Case &Mode = GAMAPiMode.Delete
			&Role.Delete()
	EndCase
	If &Role.Success()
		Commit
		return
	Else
		&Errors = &Role.GetErrors()
		For &Error in &Errors
			Msg(Format(!"%1 (GAM%2)", &Error.Message, &Error.Code))
		EndFor
	Endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(&Mode, &Id);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Start (Event) ---
&ApplicationId.Clear()

	EndFor
	If &ApplicationId.Count = 2
		&ApplicationId = &Application.Id
	Else
		&ApplicationId = &pApplicationId
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&GridPageSize = Grid.Rows
	&GAMRole.Load(&RoleId)
	&RolePermissionFilter.ApplicationId = &ApplicationId
	&RolePermissionFilter.Name			= !'%' + &FilName
	&RolePermissionFilter.AccessType.FromString(&PermissionAccessType)
	If &IsInherited.IsEmpty()
		&RolePermissionFilter.Inherited.FromString(!'A')
	Else
		&RolePermissionFilter.Inherited.FromString(&IsInherited)
	EndIf
	&GridPageCount = 0
	&GridRecordCount = 0
	If not &ApplicationId.IsEmpty()
		&Permissions = &GAMRole.GetPermissions(&RolePermissionFilter, &Errors)
		If &Permissions.Count > 0
			&GridPageCount = (&Permissions.Count/&GridPageSize) + iif(Mod(&Permissions.Count, &GridPageSize) > 0, 1, 0)
		EndIf
		&GridRecordCount = &Permissions.Count
		For &Permission in &Permissions
			&BtnDlt.FromImage(ActionDelete)
			&Id				= &Permission.GUID
			&Name 			= &Permission.Name
			&Dsc 			= GetMessageText(&Permission.Description)
			&AccessType		= &Permission.Type
			&Inherited		= &Permission.Inherited
			&old_AccessType	= &Permission.Type
			&old_Inherited	= &Permission.Inherited
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the data
	
	//Sample conditions to be added manually:
	//Where <Attribute> = &ApplicationId when not &ApplicationId.IsEmpty()
	//Where <Attribute> like &FilName when not &FilName.IsEmpty()
	//Where <Attribute> = &PermissionAccessType when not &PermissionAccessType.IsEmpty()
	//Where <Attribute> = &IsInherited when not &IsInherited.IsEmpty()
	
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
			Grid.Load()
		EndFor
	EndIf

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'GAMWWRolePermissionsFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'GAMWWRolePermissionsFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'GAMWWRolePermissionsFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoBack' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Back)
		GAMWWRoles.Call()
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
If not &ApplicationId.IsEmpty()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		GAMRolePermissionSelect.Call(&RoleId, &ApplicationId)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
  Else
		Msg("WWP_GAM_SelectApplication")
	EndIf

--- 'DoSave' (Event) ---
&GAMRole.Load(&RoleId)
	For each line
		If &AccessType <> &old_AccessType  or &Inherited <> &old_Inherited
			&PermissionUpd.ApplicationId= &ApplicationId
			&PermissionUpd.GUID		  	= &Id
			&PermissionUpd.Type.FromString(&AccessType)
			&PermissionUpd.Inherited	= &Inherited
			&isOK = &GAMRole.UpdatePermission(&PermissionUpd, &Errors)
			If not &isOK
				For &Error in &Errors
					Msg(Format(!"%1 (GAM%2)", &Error.Message, &Error.Code))
				EndFor
				Exit
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndFor
	If &isOK
		Commit
		Msg("Changes saved successfully.")
	Else
		For &Error in &Errors
			Msg(Format(!"%1 (GAM%2)", &Error.Message, &Error.Code))
		EndFor
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdExport' (Event) ---
ExportarPermisosPorRol.Call(&RoleId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdImport' (Event) ---
wpImportarPermisosPorRol.Call(&RoleId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&RoleId, in:&pApplicationId);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&GridPageSize = Grid.Rows
  &GAMRole.Load(&RoleIdAux)
	If not &FilName.IsEmpty()
		&Filter.Name	= !"%" + &FilName	
	Else
		&Filter.Name	= !"%" + &SearchFilter
	Endif	
	&Filter.ExternalId 	= !"%" + &FilExternalId
	&Roles = &GAMRole.GetChildren(&Filter, &Errors)
	If &Roles.Count = 0
		&GridPageCount = 0
	Else
		&GridPageCount = (&Roles.Count/&GridPageSize) + iif(Mod(&Roles.Count, &GridPageSize) > 0, 1, 0)
	EndIf
	&GridRecordCount = &Roles.Count
	For &Role in &Roles
		&Id	  = &Role.Id
		&Name = &Role.Name
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the data
	
	//Sample conditions to be added manually:
	//Where <Attribute> like &FilName when not &FilName.IsEmpty()
	//Where <Attribute> like &FilExternalId when not &FilExternalId.IsEmpty()
	
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = GAMRoleEntry.Link(GAMAPiMode.Update, &Id)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	Grid.Load()
	
	EndFor

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'GAMWWRoleRolesFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'GAMWWRoleRolesFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'GAMWWRoleRolesFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoBack' (Event) ---
If &ListCount <= 1
		&WebSession.Remove("RoleList")
		return
	Else
		&RoleList.Remove(&ListCount)
		&RoleIdList = &RoleList.Item(&ListCount-1)
		&WebSession.Set("RoleList", &RoleList.ToJson())
		GAMWWRoleRoles(&RoleId, &RoleIdList)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		GAMRoleSelect.Call(&RoleId, &RoleIdAux)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &Delete.Click (Event) ---
&GAMRole.Load(&RoleIdAux)
	&isOK = &GAMRole.DeleteRoleById(&Id, &Errors)
	If &isOK
		Commit
	Else
		For &Error in &Errors
			Msg(Format(!"%1 (GAM%2)", &Error.Message, &Error.Code))
		EndFor	
	EndIf
	Refresh

		&WWPEntityId = WWPEntityId
		&EntityHasItemsToShow = False
		&NotificationsForEntityCount = Count(WWPNotificationDefinitionDescription, WWPNotificationDefinitionAppliesTo = Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord)
		If &NotificationsForEntityCount > 0 And Not &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents
			&EntityHasItemsToShow = True
		Else
			&SubscriptionsForEntityCount = Count(WWPSubscriptionSubscribed, WWPSubscriptionRoleId = &WWPSubscriptionRoleId)
			If &SubscriptionsForEntityCount > 0
				&EntityHasItemsToShow = True
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If &EntityHasItemsToShow
			&GridRecordCount += 1
			Load
		EndIf
		
	EndFor
	&GridPageCount = &GridRecordCount/Grid.Rows + iif(Mod(&GridRecordCount, Grid.Rows) > 0, 1, 0)

--- &DetailWebComponent.Click (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid_DWC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsSettingsByRoleWC.Create(&WWPEntityId, &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents, &WWPSubscriptionRoleId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents.Click (Event) ---
Grid_DWC.Refresh()

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&WWPSubscriptionRoleId);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Root.ExportarPermisosPorRol ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&FileName = !'Permisos' + &GAMRole.Name.Trim() + !'.csv'
&ok= DFWOpen(&FileName, !',' , !'', 0, 'utf_8')
if(&ok = 0)	
	&GAMRole.Load(&RoleId)
	&Permissions = &GAMRole.GetPermissions(&RolePermissionFilter, &GAMErrors)

	If &Permissions.Count = 0
		&varchar = 'Sin Permisos'
		&ok = DFWPTXT(&varchar, &varchar.Length())
		&ok = DFWNext()
	Else
		
			For &Permission in &Permissions
				
				&varchar = &Permission.GUID.Trim() + '|' + &Permission.Name.Trim() + '|'+ &Permission.Description.ToString().Trim()+ '|' + &Permission.Type + '|' + &Permission.Inherited.ToString().Trim()  +'|' +&Permission.ApplicationId.ToString().Trim()
				
				&ok = DFWPTXT(&varchar, &varchar.Length())
				&ok = DFWNext()
			EndFor		
	EndIf
else
	msg('Error al generar el archivo')
endif	

&ok = DFWClose()

&HttpResponse.AddHeader(!'Content-Type',!'text/csv')
&HttpResponse.AddHeader(!'Content-Disposition',!'attachment;filename=' + !'archivo.csv')
&HttpResponse.AddFile(&FileName)

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&RoleId);

	&AppId = &ApplicationId
	&PermissionFilter.ApplicationId = &AppId
	&PermissionFilter.Name			= &FilName
	&PermissionFilter.AccessType.FromString(&PermissionAccessType)
	&PermissionFilter.Inherited.FromString(&BoolenFilter)
	&GamPermissions = &GAMRole.GetUnassignedPermissions(&PermissionFilter, &Errors) 
	if &GamPermissions.count=0
		&GridPageCount=0
	else

	endif

	&Name.Link = Link("GAMAppPermissionEntry", GAMAPiMode.Display, &ApplicationId, &Id)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
			Grid.Load()
		EndFor
	Endif

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'GAMRolePermissionSelectFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'GAMRolePermissionSelectFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'GAMRolePermissionSelectFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoAdd' (Event) ---
&GAMRole.Load(&RoleId)	
	For each line
		If &Select
			&PermissionAdd.ApplicationId= &AppId
			&PermissionAdd.GUID		  	= &Id
			&PermissionAdd.Type.FromString(&Access)
			&isOK = &GAMRole.AddPermission(&PermissionAdd, &Errors)
			If not &isOK
				For &Error in &Errors
					Msg(Format(!"%1 (GAM%2)", &Error.Message, &Error.Code))
				EndFor	
				Exit
			Endif		
		Endif
	EndFor
	If &isOK
		Commit
		GAMWWRolePermissions(&RoleId, &ApplicationId)
	Else
		For &Error in &Errors
			Msg(Format(!"%1 (GAM%2)", &Error.Message, &Error.Code))
		EndFor		
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

=== Procedure: Produccion.ObtenerConfiguracion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
FOR EACH DB.Configuracion
	WHERE ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
	&ConfiguracionValor = ConfiguracionValor
	EXIT
WHEN NONE
	new 
		ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
		ConfiguracionValor = ''
	endnew
	commit
ENDFOR

--- Rules (Rules) ---
PARM(IN:&ConfiguracionKey, OUT:&ConfiguracionValor);

=== Transaction: DB.Configuracion ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		btn_Enter.Caption = "GX_BtnDelete"
		btn_Enter.TooltipText = "GX_BtnDelete"
	EndIf
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWConfiguracion()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ConfiguracionKey);

noaccept(ConfiguracionKey) if not &ConfiguracionKey.IsEmpty();
noprompt(ConfiguracionKey);
}
